SELECT current, previous,
       (current - previous) * 100.0 / NULLIF(previous, 0) AS change_percent
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= {start_us} THEN service_oma_session_id END) AS current,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp < {start_us} THEN service_oma_session_id END) AS previous
  FROM oma_claude_code
  WHERE {scope} AND 1=1
)

SELECT current, previous,
       (current - previous) * 100.0 / NULLIF(previous, 0) AS change_percent
FROM (
  SELECT
    AVG(CASE WHEN _timestamp >= {start_us} THEN CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE) END) AS current,

SELECT current, previous,
       (current - previous) * 100.0 / NULLIF(previous, 0) AS change_percent
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= {start_us} AND success = 'false' THEN service_oma_session_id END) * 100.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp >= {start_us} THEN service_oma_session_id END), 0) AS current,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp < {start_us} AND success = 'false' THEN service_oma_session_id END) * 100.0
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN _timestamp < {start_us} THEN service_oma_session_id END), 0) AS previous
  FROM oma_claude_code
  WHERE {scope} AND 1=1
)

SELECT model AS model,
       SUM(COALESCE(CAST(input_tokens AS BIGINT), 0)) AS input_tokens,
       SUM(COALESCE(CAST(output_tokens AS BIGINT), 0)) AS output_tokens,
       SUM(COALESCE(CAST(cache_read_tokens AS BIGINT), 0)) AS cache_read_tokens,
       SUM(COALESCE(CAST(cache_creation_tokens AS BIGINT), 0)) AS cache_creation_tokens,
       SUM((COALESCE(CAST(input_tokens AS BIGINT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(output_tokens AS BIGINT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(cache_read_tokens AS BIGINT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(cache_creation_tokens AS BIGINT), 0))) AS token_total,
       COUNT(*) AS requests,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN success = 'false' THEN 1 END) AS errors,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN success = 'false' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS failure_rate,
       AVG(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_duration_ms,
       approx_percentile_cont(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.95) AS p95_duration_ms,
       approx_percentile_cont(CAST(duration_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.99) AS p99_duration_ms,
       AVG(CASE WHEN success = 'true' AND ttft_ms IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(ttft_ms AS DOUBLE) END) AS avg_ttft_ms
FROM oma_claude_code
WHERE {scope} AND operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' AND {model_filter}
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY token_total DESC

SELECT current, previous,
       (current - previous) * 100.0 / NULLIF(previous, 0) AS change_percent
FROM (
  SELECT
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p._timestamp >= {start_us} AND e.success = 'false' THEN 1 END) AS current,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN p._timestamp < {start_us} AND e.success = 'false' THEN 1 END) AS previous
  FROM oma_claude_code p
LEFT JOIN oma_claude_code e
  ON e.reference_parent_span_id = p.span_id
 AND e.operation_name = 'claude_code.tool.execution'
 AND {scope:e}
WHERE {scope:p} AND p.operation_name = 'claude_code.tool' AND {tool_filter:p}
)

FROM oma_claude_code

GROUP BY timestamp

SELECT histogram(p._timestamp, '{bucket_interval}') AS timestamp,
       'errors' AS series,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN e.success = 'false' THEN 1 END) AS value
FROM oma_claude_code p
LEFT JOIN oma_claude_code e
  ON e.reference_parent_span_id = p.span_id
 AND e.operation_name = 'claude_code.tool.execution'
 AND {scope:e}
WHERE {scope:p} AND p.operation_name = 'claude_code.tool' AND {tool_filter:p}
GROUP BY timestamp

SELECT p.tool_name AS tool_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.span_id) AS calls,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN e.success = 'false' THEN 1 END) AS errors,
       AVG(CAST(p.duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS avg_duration_ms,
       approx_percentile_cont(CAST(p.duration_ms AS DOUBLE), 0.95) AS p95_duration_ms,
       MAX(CAST(p.duration_ms AS DOUBLE)) AS max_duration_ms
FROM oma_claude_code p
LEFT JOIN oma_claude_code e
  ON e.reference_parent_span_id = p.span_id
 AND e.operation_name = 'claude_code.tool.execution'
 AND {scope:e}
WHERE {scope:p} AND p.operation_name = 'claude_code.tool' AND {tool_filter:p}
GROUP BY p.tool_name
ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '{bucket_interval}') AS timestamp,

SELECT histogram(_timestamp, '{bucket_interval}') AS timestamp,
       'errors' AS series,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN operation_name IN ('claude_code.llm_request', 'claude_code.tool.execution') AND success = 'false' THEN trace_id END) AS value
FROM oma_claude_code
WHERE {scope} AND 1=1
GROUP BY timestamp

SELECT trace_id,
       MAX(service_oma_session_id) AS session_id,
       MAX(service_oma_agent_id) AS agent_id,
       MIN(start_time) AS start_time,
       MAX(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.interaction'
                THEN CAST(interaction_duration_ms AS DOUBLE) END) AS duration_ms,
       SUM(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' THEN
             (COALESCE(CAST(input_tokens AS BIGINT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(output_tokens AS BIGINT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(cache_read_tokens AS BIGINT), 0) + COALESCE(CAST(cache_creation_tokens AS BIGINT), 0))
           ELSE 0 END) AS tokens,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' THEN 1 END) AS llm_calls,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.tool' THEN 1 END) AS tool_calls,
       MAX(CASE WHEN operation_name IN ('claude_code.llm_request', 'claude_code.tool.execution')
                 AND success = 'false' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_error,
       MAX(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.interaction'
                THEN substr(CAST(user_prompt AS VARCHAR), 1, 240) END) AS input,
       MAX(CASE WHEN operation_name = 'claude_code.llm_request' AND success = 'true'
                THEN concat(lpad(CAST(start_time AS VARCHAR), 24, '0'), substr(CAST(response_model_output AS VARCHAR), 1, 240)) END) AS output
FROM oma_claude_code
WHERE {scope} AND {trace_id_filter}
GROUP BY trace_id
{status_having}
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 51 OFFSET {offset}
